Class Night

java.lang.Object
echoshift.nightscripts.Night
public class Night extends Object
This class handles the Logic of a Night/level for the Echo Shift game.

  • Constructor Details

    • Night

      public Night(int nightNum, Entity entity, MapRenderer mapRenderer)
      The constructor for the Night class. This keeps a record of the Entity and the map of the Night. This constructor also sets the initial difficulty of the Night.
      Parameters:
      nightNum - The level selected by the player.
      entity - The enemy for this level.
      mapRenderer - The graphic instructions for the Map.
